headline: OCBC Ranks as Asia-Pacific's Strongest Bank and Third Globally
summary: OCBC was ranked as the strongest bank in the Asia-Pacific region and third globally by The Asian Banker, marking the first time a Singapore bank entered the global top three.
why: Bank strength rankings evaluate balance sheet stability, asset quality, capitalization, and liquidity, serving as key indicators of financial sector health in major banking hubs.

impacts.name: OCBC
impacts.why: Global recognition of financial strength underscores robust asset quality and capital adequacy.
